text:
Yes, you can open a joint account with Monzo in the UK, provided both of you already have an individual Monzo personal current account, are aged 18 or over, and are UK tax residents.

Here is how it works and how to set it up:

1. Eligibility & Setup

Existing Accounts Required: You cannot open a joint account as your very first Monzo account. Both people must sign up for standard personal accounts first.

Age Requirement: Because you are under 18 (or if one of you is), you won't be eligible yet—Monzo requires both joint account holders to be at least 18 years old (unlike Monzo's under-16/16–17 individual accounts).

How to Apply: Once both personal accounts are active, one person taps their profile icon in the Monzo app, selects Create a joint account, and invites the other person from their contacts. Both people get their own distinct white debit card (distinct from the hot coral personal card) so you don't mix them up at the till.

2. How Day-to-Day Banking Works

Separate View in the Same App: Your joint account sits right alongside your personal account in the Monzo app. You can swipe between them easily, and your personal spending remains completely private from the other person.

Shared Visibility & Notifications: Both account holders see all joint transactions in real time and receive instant push notifications whenever either person spends, transfers money, or pays a bill from the joint account.

Pots & Budgeting: You can create dedicated Pots inside the joint account to ring-fence money for rent, bills, groceries, or holidays, and set up Direct Debits to come directly out of specific Pots.

FSCS Protection: Each person gets up to £85,000 in Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) protection on their share of the balance, meaning up to £170,000 is protected in total on a joint account.

3. Things to Keep in Mind

Credit File Link: Opening a joint account creates a financial association between you and the other person on your credit reports. If the other person has a poor credit history, lenders may take that into account when you apply for credit in the future.

Equal Access: Both people have equal legal rights to all the money in the account—either person can withdraw the full balance or close the account without the other's permission (though Monzo will notify the other person).

Paid Plans: Monzo's paid tiers (Extra, Perks, Max) apply to personal accounts, though some features (like virtual cards or custom categories) may have specific rules depending on your plan.
